span.p:
PHASE 1: Environment Setup
✅ Dependencies, topologies, baseline validation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Initialize:
• Load experiment_config.json
• Set Seed = 42 (primary)
• Create output directories

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Load Topology T
• Internet2: 11 nodes
• ATT-MPLS: 21 nodes
• Synthetic-BA: 15 nodes

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🔄 Iterate Through
4 Algorithms
(Greedy, DQN, Random, Baseline)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
GREEDY k-CENTER
1. Farthest-first heuristic
2. O(nk) complexity
Expected ω ≈ 0.00002 s

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DQN TRAINING
1. Initialize neural network
2. Train 1,000 episodes
3. Extract greedy policy
Expected ω ≈ 0.0226 s

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RANDOM PLACEMENT
1. Uniformly sample k nodes
2. Return random set P
Expected ω ≈ 0.000001 s

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
BASELINE HEURISTIC
1. Alternative k-center variant
2. Medoid-based selection
Expected ω ≈ 0.00002 s

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TRIAL EXECUTION
per [A, T, k, Seed] combination

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MEASUREMENT PHASE
For resulting placement P:

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
📏 Latency L(P)
1. Compute shortest-paths (Floyd-Warshall)
2. Find min dist to controller per node
3. Average across all nodes
4. Report: XX.XXXX ms

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🛡️ Reliability R_avg(P)
1. FOR each link e ∈ E:
• Remove link e
• Check all nodes reachable?
2. Average reachability indicator
3. Report: 0.XXXX [0.0–1.0]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⏱️ Complexity ω
1. Record wall-clock time
2. ω = (t_end - t_start) / episodes
3. Report: 0.XXXXXX seconds

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
⚖️ Secondary Metrics
• Load balance fairness
• Convergence speed (DQN)
• Worst-case distance
• Cost-benefit ratio

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RECORD TO CSV
algorithm, topology, k, seed,
latency_ms, reliability_ravg,
complexity_s, load_std,
convergence_episodes, timestamp

PHASE 2: Data Aggregation
Consolidate all CSVs

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Consolidate:
• Read all algorithm_topology.csv
• Merge into master dataframe
• Total rows: ~10,800
• Output: experiment_master.csv

span.p:
📊 Descriptive Statistics
• Mean ± 95% CI per cell
• Latency distribution (boxplots)
• Reliability distribution
• Complexity comparison

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
📈 Inferential Analysis
• Multi-way ANOVA
H₀: No algorithm effect
• Pareto dominance (3D)
Identify non-dominated sets
• Spearman rank correlation
Cross-scenario stability

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🎨 Visualization
• Figure 1: 3D Pareto frontier
• Figure 2: Latency box plots
• Figure 3: Algorithm rank heatmap
• Figure 4: DQN convergence curve
• Figure 5: Complexity log-scale bar

span.p:
Interpret Results:
• Which algorithms Pareto-optimal?
• How stable across scenarios?
• Cost-benefit analysis (gain/ω)
• Recommendation matrix
